svg.desc: L0 Law axioms plus Baseline; L1 Kernels Host and Peer; L2 Bound work Activity Context inject limit isolate lineage reverse part; L3 Correlate trace; L4 Negotiate profile; L5 Drivers domain Ops; L6 Policy optional; L7 Application product logic.
